content.text: The campaign and line item are both active and serving. I'll let the first day run, then check delivery and approval status.

The first nine hours show 6,540 impressions, 7 link clicks and 10.95 USD spent, with all four posts accepted. That is a low click rate early on, so I'll check per-post results after the next full day.

Through Dec 8 06:00 UTC (Nairobi 09:00 on Dec 8), the campaign has 38,315 impressions, 28 link clicks and 40.48 USD spent. The per-post results are still small, so I'm not making changes yet. The first post has 4 clicks and the friend-twist invitation post has 11, but these samples are too small to rank the posts. Spend is pacing at about 33 USD per day against a 33.33 USD daily cap, so the 400 USD total should last the flight. I'll keep checking.

Through Dec 10 06:00 UTC: 100.05 USD spent, 120,609 impressions, 64 link clicks. The four posts have similar cost per link click (about 1.54 to 1.67 USD), so there's no clear loser yet, and I'm leaving the mix unchanged. I'll keep checking through the flight.

Through Dec 13 06:00 UTC: 196.31 USD spent, 231,137 impressions, 119 link clicks. Spend is pacing at about 32 USD a day, so the 400 USD total should carry through Dec 18. Cost per link click is about 1.62 to 1.67 USD on all four posts, so the mix stays as is. I'll check again mid-week.
